pairs.target: fēng láng de mén yìkāi , tǎ wéi xiān wénjiàn le yǔ hòu de shítou wèi .
pairs.english: As soon as the wind gallery's door opened, Tavi first caught the smell of stone after rain.
pairs.hanzi: 风廊的门一开，塔维先闻见了雨后的石头味。

pairs.target: zhè shì rùxué dìèrshísān tiān de xiàwǔ .
pairs.english: It was the afternoon of his twenty-third day at school.
pairs.hanzi: 这是入学第二十三天的下午。

pairs.target: xīn kè pái zài xīlóu , tā yánzhe lóutī páshànglái ,
pairs.english: The new class was scheduled in the west building. He climbed up the stairs,
pairs.hanzi: 新课排在西楼，他沿着楼梯爬上来，

pairs.target: cái fāxiàn zhěngtiáo chángláng shēnchū le shānbì .
pairs.english: only to discover that the whole long gallery projected from the mountainside.
pairs.hanzi: 才发现整条长廊伸出了山壁。

pairs.target: chuāngwài méiyǒu yuànzi , zhǐyǒu yìcéng báoyún ;
pairs.english: Outside the windows there was no courtyard, only a layer of thin cloud;
pairs.hanzi: 窗外没有院子，只有一层薄云；

pairs.target: yún dǐ ǒuěr lièkāi , lùchū hěn yuǎn de yìxiǎokuài tītián .
pairs.english: the bottom of the cloud occasionally parted, revealing a little patch of terraced fields far away.
pairs.hanzi: 云底偶尔裂开，露出很远的一小块梯田。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī zhèng ná jiānbǎng dǐng zhe yíshàn chuāng , jiào zuìxiān dào de rén bāngmáng chāxiāo .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian was bracing a window with his shoulder, asking the first arrivals to help slide the bolt home.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师正拿肩膀顶着一扇窗，叫最先到的人帮忙插销。

pairs.target: tā sǎngzi yǎ , shuō chángjù fèijìn ,
pairs.english: His voice was hoarse, and long sentences took effort,
pairs.hanzi: 他嗓子哑，说长句费劲，

pairs.target: biàn yòng fěnbǐ zài zhuō yán xiě le sāngè zì : xiān guānchuāng .
pairs.english: so he used chalk to write three characters on the table's edge: Close windows first.
pairs.hanzi: 便用粉笔在桌沿写了三个字：先关窗。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fàngxià shūdài , hé luò héng yìqǐ tuī .
pairs.english: Tavi put down his book bag and pushed together with Lohen.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维放下书袋，和洛衡一起推。

pairs.target: chuāngkuàng xià yǒu yìkē sōngdòng de tóngdīng , cā zhe shítái , xiǎng dé xiàng yǒurén móyá .
pairs.english: Beneath the window frame, a loose copper nail scraped the stone sill, making a noise like someone grinding their teeth.
pairs.hanzi: 窗框下有一颗松动的铜钉，擦着石台，响得像有人磨牙。

pairs.target: chāxiāo zhōngyú luò le kǒng , wūlǐ yíxià ānjìng ,
pairs.english: The bolt finally dropped into its hole. The room went quiet at once,
pairs.hanzi: 插销终于落了孔，屋里一下安静，

pairs.target: zhī shèng zhòngrén wǎng dùzǐ lǐ xīqì de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: with only the sound of everyone drawing breath deep into their bellies.
pairs.hanzi: 只剩众人往肚子里吸气的声音。

pairs.target: " yǐhòu bié děng wǒ . " jiǎn lǎoshī zhǐzhǐ zhuōshàng de zì , bǎ fěnbǐ shōu jìn kǒudài .
pairs.english: “Next time, don't wait for me.” Instructor Jian pointed at the writing on the table and put the chalk away in his pocket.
pairs.hanzi: “以后别等我。”简老师指指桌上的字，把粉笔收进口袋。

pairs.target: chángzhuō liǎngpáng gè yǒu xiǎo jiàzi .
pairs.english: There were small stands on each side of the long table.
pairs.hanzi: 长桌两旁各有小架子。

pairs.target: liǎngpiàn gāngtiáo jiá zài jiàshàng , mòduān diào zhe děng zhòng de xìxiǎo tóngkuài ,
pairs.english: Two steel strips were clamped to a stand, their ends hung with tiny copper weights of equal weight,
pairs.hanzi: 两片钢条夹在架上，末端吊着等重的细小铜块，

pairs.target: pángbiān shù zhe kèxiàn bǎn , hé wéi lǎoshī kè shàng de zhuāngzhì hěn xiàng ,
pairs.english: with a graduated board standing beside them, much like the apparatus in Instructor Vey's class,
pairs.hanzi: 旁边竖着刻线板，和维老师课上的装置很像，

pairs.target: zhǐshì wàimiàn duō le yígèsānmiàn wéi hé de bōlízhào .
pairs.english: except for the addition of a glass enclosure surrounding three sides.
pairs.hanzi: 只是外面多了一个三面围合的玻璃罩。

pairs.target: zhàozǐ cháo rén zuò de nàbiān chǎngzhe , shǒu kěyǐ shēnjìnqù .
pairs.english: The enclosure was open on the side where a person sat, so hands could reach inside.
pairs.hanzi: 罩子朝人坐的那边敞着，手可以伸进去。

pairs.target: jīntiān huàn dādàng .
pairs.english: Today they were changing partners.
pairs.hanzi: 今天换搭档。

pairs.target: mǐlā qù le duìmiàn , yīwén bèijiào dào kào mén de yìzhuō ,
pairs.english: Mira went to the opposite side; Iven was called to a table near the door,
pairs.hanzi: 米拉去了对面，伊文被叫到靠门的一桌，

pairs.target: tǎ wéihé luò héng liúzài gāngguān hǎo de chuāng xià .
pairs.english: and Tavi and Lohen stayed beneath the window they had just shut.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维和洛衡留在刚关好的窗下。

pairs.target: tā mō dào gāngtiáo gānjìng de biānyuán , xīnlǐ sōngkuài le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: He felt the clean edge of the steel strip and grew a little more cheerful.
pairs.hanzi: 他摸到钢条干净的边缘，心里松快了一点。

pairs.target: zhìshǎo zhè búshì yìtáng yào xiān chāo mǎn liǎngyè zì de kè .
pairs.english: At least this wasn't a class that required copying two full pages of writing first.
pairs.hanzi: 至少这不是一堂要先抄满两页字的课。

pairs.target: " nǐ jì ba . " tā bǎ jìlùzhǐ tuīxiàng luò héng , " nǐ de zì kuài . "
pairs.english: “You take notes.” He pushed the record sheet toward Lohen. “You write fast.”
pairs.hanzi: “你记吧。”他把记录纸推向洛衡，“你的字快。”

pairs.target: luò héng méi jiē , xiān bǎ zhǐ zhuǎn le bànquān .
pairs.english: Lohen didn't take it. First he turned the paper halfway around.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡没接，先把纸转了半圈。

pairs.target: " shàng huí wǒ yě jì . jīntiān wǒ xiān zuò . "
pairs.english: “I took notes last time too. Today I go first.”
pairs.hanzi: “上回我也记。今天我先做。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de shǒu hái dā zài jià biān .
pairs.english: Tavi's hand was still resting beside the stand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的手还搭在架边。

pairs.target: tā běnlái yǐjīng xiǎng hǎo le , liǎngxià jiù néng zhǎozhǔn , bǐ shàngcì zuò dé gèngwěn .
pairs.english: He had already imagined finding the right balance in a couple of tries, doing it more steadily than last time.
pairs.hanzi: 他本来已经想好了，两下就能找准，比上次做得更稳。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng què yìn zhe liǎng lán , měigè rén dōu dé liúxià zìjǐ de jiéguǒ .
pairs.english: But two columns were printed on the paper; each person had to leave their own result.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上却印着两栏，每个人都得留下自己的结果。

pairs.target: " xíng . " tā shuō , bǎ dèngzǐ ràng chūlái .
pairs.english: “Fine,” he said, giving up the stool.
pairs.hanzi: “行。”他说，把凳子让出来。

pairs.target: dèng jiǎo kǎ zài zhuān fènglǐ , lā dé zhòng le , fāchū cìěr de yìshēng .
pairs.english: Its leg caught in a gap between bricks; he pulled too hard, producing a piercing scrape.
pairs.hanzi: 凳脚卡在砖缝里，拉得重了，发出刺耳的一声。

pairs.target: luò héng kàn tā yìyǎn , méi shuōhuà .
pairs.english: Lohen glanced at him and said nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡看他一眼，没说话。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī zhú zhuō kànguò jiājù hé tóngkuài ,
pairs.english: Instructor Jian went from table to table checking the clamps and copper weights,
pairs.hanzi: 简老师逐桌看过夹具和铜块，

pairs.target: ràng tāmen xiāndú wèizhì , zài pèng gāngtiáo .
pairs.english: telling them to read the positions first, then touch the steel strips.
pairs.hanzi: 让他们先读位置，再碰钢条。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dūn dī , zhàozhe kèxiàn bǎnbào le shù .
pairs.english: Tavi crouched low and called out the readings from the graduated board.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维蹲低，照着刻线板报了数。

pairs.target: luò héng fùshù yíbiàn , cái bǎ liǎngzhīshǒu fēnbié dāshàngqù .
pairs.english: Lohen repeated them once before resting his two hands on the separate strips.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡复述一遍，才把两只手分别搭上去。

pairs.target: tā zuò dé hěn màn . dìyīpiàn mòduān jiànjiàn dī le yìdiǎn ,
pairs.english: He worked very slowly. The end of the first strip gradually dropped a little,
pairs.hanzi: 他做得很慢。第一片末端渐渐低了一点，

pairs.target: lìng yípiàn wǎng shàng nuó , tíngzhù .
pairs.english: the other strip moved upward, then stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 另一片往上挪，停住。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng zhe tā zài dòng , zhídào luò héng sōngshǒu , liǎngbiān huídào yuánchù .
pairs.english: Tavi waited for it to move again, until Lohen let go and both sides returned to their original positions.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等着它再动，直到洛衡松手，两边回到原处。

pairs.target: " zhème xiǎo ? " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “That small?” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “这么小？”塔维说。

pairs.target: luò héng dītóu jiǎnchá shǒuzhǐ , mǔzhǐ yīcì dǐ guò qíyú sì zhǐ , cái wèn :
pairs.english: Lohen lowered his head to check his fingers, touching each of the other four fingers with his thumb in turn, before asking:
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡低头检查手指，拇指依次抵过其余四指，才问：

pairs.target: " xiǎo jiù búyòng jì ? "
pairs.english: “So small means it needn't be recorded?”
pairs.hanzi: “小就不用记？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ lājìn . nàge biànhuà quèshí yǒu , zhǐshì bǐ tā děng zhe kàn de xiǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi pulled the paper closer. That change had certainly happened; it was just smaller than the one he had been waiting to see.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把纸拉近。那个变化确实有，只是比他等着看的小。

pairs.target: tā zài liǎng lán xiàmiàn gè huà le yì duǎnxiàn , biāo shàng fāngxiàng .
pairs.english: He drew a short line below each of the two columns and marked the direction.
pairs.hanzi: 他在两栏下面各画了一短线，标上方向。

pairs.target: lún dào tā shí , chuāngwài hūrán liàng le , yún bèi fēng tuīkāi , tītián yìcéngcéng lùchū lái .
pairs.english: When his turn came, it suddenly brightened outside the window; wind pushed the cloud aside, revealing terrace after terrace of fields.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到他时，窗外忽然亮了，云被风推开，梯田一层层露出来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng xiǎng jiào rén kàn , shēnhòu biàn yǒurén hǎn : " xiàmiàn yǒu chē ! "
pairs.english: Tavi was just about to tell someone to look when someone behind him shouted, “There's a cart below!”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚想叫人看，身后便有人喊：“下面有车！”

pairs.target: tā piān le yíxiàtóu , zhǐ xià hǎobùróngyì fēnqīng de liǎngchù qiānchě dùnshí hùn zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: He tilted his head a little, and the two tugs beneath his fingers that he had only just managed to distinguish immediately blurred together.
pairs.hanzi: 他偏了一下头，指下好不容易分清的两处牵扯顿时混在一起。

pairs.target: tā sōngkāi shǒu , fǔshēn chóngxīn zhǎo kèxiàn .
pairs.english: He released his hands and bent down to find the graduation marks again.
pairs.hanzi: 他松开手，俯身重新找刻线。

pairs.target: luò héng yǐjīng zài zhǐ shàng xiě le " wèi chéng ".
pairs.english: Lohen had already written “unsuccessful” on the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡已经在纸上写了“未成”。

pairs.target: " wǒ hái méi kāishǐ . "
pairs.english: “I hadn't started yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “我还没开始。”

pairs.target: " nǐ pèng le . "
pairs.english: “You touched them.”
pairs.hanzi: “你碰了。”

pairs.target: " pèng le bù děngyú ——"
pairs.english: “Touching isn't the same as—”
pairs.hanzi: “碰了不等于——”

pairs.target: chuāngkuàng yòu xiǎng qǐlái , bǎ tā hòu bànjù gàizhù le .
pairs.english: The window frame began rattling again, drowning out the second half of his sentence.
pairs.hanzi: 窗框又响起来，把他后半句盖住了。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī zǒu guòlái , méiyǒu wèn shuí duì shuícuò , xiān ànzhù nà kē sōng dīng , zài kàn jìlù .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian came over. Without asking who was right or wrong, he first held down the loose nail, then looked at the record.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师走过来，没有问谁对谁错，先按住那颗松钉，再看记录。

pairs.target: " xiǎng jì shénme jiù shuō qīngchǔ . shǒu fàngshàngqù , háishì yǐjīng jiè shàng le ?
pairs.english: “Be clear about what you want to record. Hands placed on them, or borrowing already established?
pairs.hanzi: “想记什么就说清楚。手放上去，还是已经借上了？

pairs.target: zhè liǎngjiànshì dé fēnkāi . "
pairs.english: Those two things need to be kept separate.”
pairs.hanzi: 这两件事得分开。”

pairs.target: tā zài pángbiān liú le liǎnggè xiǎogé , ràng tāmen zìjǐ tián ,
pairs.english: He left two small boxes beside it for them to fill in themselves,
pairs.hanzi: 他在旁边留了两个小格，让他们自己填，

pairs.target: suíjí wānyāo zhǎo chuāngkuàng shàng quē de diànpiàn .
pairs.english: then immediately bent down to look for the shim missing from the window frame.
pairs.hanzi: 随即弯腰找窗框上缺的垫片。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn luò héng bǎ nà liǎnggè zì huà qù , huànchéng le " jiēchù , zhōngzhǐ ".
pairs.english: Tavi saw Lohen cross out those two characters and replace them with “contact; stopped.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见洛衡把那两个字划去，换成了“接触，中止”。

pairs.target: " wǒ méi kànjiàn nǐ nàbiān dòng . " luò héng shuō .
pairs.english: “I didn't see your side move,” Lohen said.
pairs.hanzi: “我没看见你那边动。”洛衡说。

pairs.target: " wǒ yě méi kànqīng . "
pairs.english: “I didn't see clearly either.”
pairs.hanzi: “我也没看清。”

pairs.target: zhè jù huà shuōwán , tǎ wéi xiōngkǒu nà gǔ yìngqì cái sàn le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Only after saying this did a little of the stubbornness in Tavi's chest dissipate.
pairs.hanzi: 这句话说完，塔维胸口那股硬气才散了一点。

pairs.target: tā ná qǐ zhǐ , bǔ shàng zìjǐ de míngzì .
pairs.english: He picked up the paper and added his own name.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿起纸，补上自己的名字。

pairs.target: xiūxi shí , jiǎn lǎoshī bǎ chuāng tuīkāi yì zhǐ kuān .
pairs.english: During the break, Instructor Jian pushed the window open a finger's width.
pairs.hanzi: 休息时，简老师把窗推开一指宽。

pairs.target: lěngfēng zuānjìnlái , zhuō wài xuán zhe de xìshéng lìkè wāixiàng yìbiān ,
pairs.english: Cold wind slipped inside, and the thin cord hanging outside the table immediately slanted to one side,
pairs.hanzi: 冷风钻进来，桌外悬着的细绳立刻歪向一边，

pairs.target: bōlízhào lǐ de tóngkuài què zhī qīngqīng huàng le huàng .
pairs.english: but the copper weights inside the glass enclosure only swayed gently.
pairs.hanzi: 玻璃罩里的铜块却只轻轻晃了晃。

pairs.target: tā yào tāmen kànqīng wàimiàn de fēng , bié bǎ shénme huàngdòng dōu suàn zài zìjǐ shǒushàng .
pairs.english: He wanted them to notice the wind outside, not attribute every wobble to their own hands.
pairs.hanzi: 他要他们看清外面的风，别把什么晃动都算在自己手上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu ànzhù zhǐ jiǎo , fāxiàn luò héng yìzhí dīng zhe tā gāng huà de liǎngtiáoxiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi reached out to hold down the paper's corner and found Lohen staring all along at the two lines he had just drawn.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维伸手按住纸角，发现洛衡一直盯着他刚画的两条线。

pairs.target: " nǐ gāngcái shìbushì hái xiǎng zài wǎng shàng nuó ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: “Were you trying to move it farther up just now?” he asked.
pairs.hanzi: “你刚才是不是还想再往上挪？”他问。

pairs.target: " méiyǒu . dào nàér jiù gòu le . wǒ dé xiān zhīdào zìjǐ měicì néng dào nǎér . "
pairs.english: “No. That far was enough. First I need to know how far I can get every time.”
pairs.hanzi: “没有。到那儿就够了。我得先知道自己每次能到哪儿。”

pairs.target: luò héng dùn le yíxià , yòu shuō :
pairs.english: Lohen paused briefly, then added:
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡顿了一下，又说：

pairs.target: " tóu yícì tīng gāngtiáo xiǎng , wǒ tīngbùchū qūbié .
pairs.english: “The first time I heard the steel strips ring, I couldn't hear a difference.
pairs.hanzi: “头一次听钢条响，我听不出区别。

pairs.target: pángbiān dōu shuō tīngjiàn le , wǒ yě diǎntóu . "
pairs.english: Everyone beside me said they heard it, and I nodded too.”
pairs.hanzi: 旁边都说听见了，我也点头。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi táiqǐ yǎnjīng . " hòulái ne ? "
pairs.english: Tavi raised his eyes. “And afterward?”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维抬起眼睛。
“后来呢？”

pairs.target: " hòulái xiàkè yòu tīng . ràng wéi lǎoshī yípiàn yipiàn qiāo . "
pairs.english: “Afterward I listened again after class. Asked Instructor Vey to tap them one strip at a time.”
pairs.hanzi: “后来下课又听。让维老师一片一片敲。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé bú tài qíngyuàn , xiàng bǎ yīfu lǐmiàn wāidiào de zhēnjiǎo fān gěi rén kàn .
pairs.english: He said it rather reluctantly, as though turning out a garment to show someone the crooked stitches inside.
pairs.hanzi: 他说得不太情愿，像把衣服里面歪掉的针脚翻给人看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hūrán xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ dìyīcì gēnzhe biérén shuō tīngjiàn shí , ěrduo lǐ qíshí hái liú zhe qián yìshēng .
pairs.english: Tavi suddenly remembered how, the first time he followed the others in saying he'd heard it, the previous note had actually still been lingering in his ears.
